qualification: Proved on an in-memory pool and fake lookups with the NYC buildings layer's real bytes and SHA-256; no database, object store, job dispatcher or served walk. The large path's step wiring (two lines in step()) is covered by typecheck and review, not by a run of the job.
defect: A drop in the same batch of a file whose area there was retired got no fresh area and no words: the recipe path silently rested on the old source, and the large path was offered the retired area and stopped after its retries with the generic words.
decision: Lead, 21 Oct: a same-batch redrop after retirement makes no new area. It rests in the words 'The area this file made in this batch (<area name>) is retired; nothing new is prepared from it here. Start a new batch to read this file again.' A live area keeps today's behaviour; a new batch keeps G20's :case:<caseId> rule.
delivered: intake-destination.ts: retiredFileAreaWords(caseId, sha256) finds the case's retired area holding an import package of these bytes (import_packages.body.sourceHash, both paths) and returns the words, or null; refuseRetiredFileAreaTx throws them as 409 AREA_RETIRED.

service.ts retain, both same-bytes duplicate branches: when the duplicate's area in this batch is retired the drop is refused in the words before the old source is read; nothing is written. The batch page shows a small file's refusal as its row's message (retain-batch.ts: state 'refused' with the server's words). A small redrop has no item of its own (item_id is the source id), so the refusal is that path's refusal state.

intake-large-worker.ts step(): before any phase, a large item whose file's area in this batch is retired rests at once through stopItemTx: failed_part, placement not_understood, limit_reason the words. It never reaches the destination's 409 AREA_RETIRED or a retry.
Nothing retired is restored, edited or deleted; no site is rebound; no :g<n>; bindRetainedCaseTx is unchanged.

large path: the read joins the case's site to a retired area by the import's sourceHash and gives the words; a live or absent area gives null; the words fit limit_reason
